_comment: Example drop-in fragment. Deploy with: .\config\deploy-config.ps1 -DropInName myapp -ConfigPath config\notifybridge.d\fragment.example.json. Only listed sections are merged; anything can be omitted. Fragments merge per key: broadcasts by action, settings by table/name, notifications.out by route, global routes collapse exact duplicates. This fragment forwards one app's notifications by pkg (a selective notify route - no '*' fallback here means only that app's pings reach the sink), adds a watched toggle, a power broadcast entry (with its own out) and a global route - without touching a main config.

notifications._comment: Selective forward: ONLY com.example.myapp notifications go to notify_bus as ENQ/CAN. Everything else has no matching notify route and stays off the bus. Call: render this app's calls as VOIP_* (marker classification on any package - no package list needed).

settings._comment: Example: forward Settings.System.some_toggle as event toggle on/off.
settings.name: some_toggle

broadcasts._comment: Example: power events as a charge on/off bus event with the entry's own routes.
